boardLook.title: Board look
boardLook.rowSubtitleShort: How your board renders, plus colours and shapes
boardLook.description: Choose how lit holds render on your board, and dial in every part of the look.

rendererUnavailable.title: Update the app
rendererUnavailable.body: This build can't draw the Boardsesh look yet. Update Boardsesh to unlock it — for now your board renders in Classic.

softDisc.label: Soft disc
softDisc.subtitle: Add a soft glow disc under each mark.

smallHoldBoost.label: Small-hold boost
smallHoldBoost.subtitle: Give tiny holds a bigger glow so they don't disappear.

ledDots.label: Cover LED dots
ledDots.subtitle: Hide the board art's own bright LED dots on unlit holds.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.classicOnlyNote: Marker shape, brush, and size only apply to the Classic render. In Boardsesh, the lit hold's own silhouette is the shape — turn on role glyphs below for a shape-based cue instead.

roleGlyphs.label: Role glyphs
roleGlyphs.note: Adds a shape to each lit hold — a ring, bar, or X — so roles stay easy to tell apart without colour.

cvdPalette.title: Colour-vision palettes
cvdPalette.subtitle: Apply a colour-blind-friendly palette to all four hold roles at once.
cvdPalette.note: This also lights your board in these colours, just like setting each colour by hand — except MoonBoards, which keep their own LEDs.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.pickerSubtitle: Set the lightness first, then saturation and hue.
accessibility.defaultCopy: Boardsesh will use the default colour for this hold type and skip it in Bluetooth overrides.

preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: Your markers on your board. Colours show as-is here — use the check below to see how they read.

cvd.title: Colour-blind check
cvd.subtitle: See how your markers look with different types of colour blindness, so the four roles stay easy to tell apart.
cvd.compareHint: A simulation of the marker swatches above — your real colours stay as you set them.

brush.title: Brush thickness
brush.subtitle: Change how thick overlay marker outlines are.

size.title: Marker size
size.subtitle: Change how large overlay marker shapes are.

storage.title: Storage
storage.rowSubtitle: See what your downloads take up and clear what you don't need
storage.intro: Boards you download take up space on this phone. Clear the ones you're not climbing on.
storage.offNote: Offline downloads are off right now. You can still clear what's already on this phone.
storage.reservedNote: {{size}} from boards you removed is still held on this phone. Freeing it needs room to work, so it can fail when space is tight.
storage.notKeptOffline: Not kept offline anymore — still taking up space
storage.estimateNote: Board sizes are estimates. Two sizes of the same layout share their climbs, so they won't add up to the total.
storage.removeMessage: Frees about {{size}} and stops keeping this board offline. Your sends and playlists stay put — grab it again whenever you want.
storage.removeError: Couldn't remove that board. Try again.
storage.compactFailed: Removed the climbs, but couldn't shrink the file. Free up some space and try again.
storage.removeAllMessage: Frees about {{size}} and turns downloads off for every board. Your sends and playlists stay put — they live on your account, not on this phone.
storage.emptySubtitle: Make a board available offline and it'll show up here.
storage.errorSubtitle: Something got in the way of reading what's on this phone.
storage.cachedImagesNote: Board art redraws as you browse and photos come back when you're online, so clearing this costs you a moment, not your data. Your phone can also clear it on its own when space runs low.
storage.clearCachedImagesMessage: Frees about {{size}}. Board art redraws as you browse and photos come back when you're online — your sends, playlists and downloaded boards stay put.
storage.clearCachedImagesPartial: Cleared the board art, but the photos stayed put. Open the app and try again.
storage.clearCachedImagesError: Couldn't clear the cached images. Try again.

gradeFormat.title: Grade format
gradeFormat.description: Choose how climb grades read across the app.

displayOptions.title: Display
displayOptions.playlistTagsDescription: See which playlists each climb is in, right on the list.
displayOptions.quickActionsButtonDescription: Add a ⋮ button to each climb that opens queue, tick, playlists and more. You can always long-press instead.
displayOptions.boardseshGradesDescription: Grades built from real sends across boards. The setter's grade stays until enough sends come in.

offline.title: Offline
offline.autoDownloadDescription: Download every board you use so you can browse and log sends with no signal. New boards download automatically.

language.title: Language
language.contributeSubtitle: These come from the community. Open the {{language}} files on GitHub to fix or add a phrase.

diagnostics.title: Privacy
diagnostics.recordingDescription: Send anonymous, masked session recordings so we can squash bugs faster. Your typing and photos stay hidden. Flip it off whenever you like.

syncIssues.title: Sync issues
syncIssues.description_one: 1 change couldn't sync. Retry to send it now.
syncIssues.description_other: {{count}} changes couldn't sync. Retry to send them now.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.message: You'll need to sign in again to get back to your logbook and boards.
signOut.messageOffline: Signing out removes the boards you downloaded and your offline logbook from this phone. You'll download them again next time you sign in.
signOut.pendingMessage_one: 1 change hasn't synced yet. We'll try to send it first, and anything left over is dropped.
signOut.pendingMessage_other: {{count}} changes haven't synced yet. We'll try to send them first, and anything left over is dropped.
signOut.failedMessage_one: 1 change couldn't sync, and signing out deletes it. Cancel and hit Retry sync first if you want to keep it.
signOut.failedMessage_other: {{count}} changes couldn't sync, and signing out deletes them. Cancel and hit Retry sync first if you want to keep them.
signOut.failure: Boardsesh couldn't confirm sign-out. Reconnect and sign out again before leaving this device.

about.title: About
about.heroBody: Run your board from your phone: find climbs, line up sends, light the wall, and keep the session moving.
about.whatItDoesBody: Search, queue, light, log, and share climbs from one place while you stay focused on the wall.
about.boardsBody: Boardsesh supports sessions on your Kilter, Tension, and MoonBoard setups without pretending to be an official app.
about.openBody: The project is open source so climbers can report rough edges, request features, and help steer what comes next.
about.independentBody: Boardsesh is not affiliated with or endorsed by Aurora Climbing, Kilter, Tension, Moon Climbing, or any board manufacturer.
about.partnerBody: Boardsesh works with Kilter, Tension, and MoonBoard from the outside. If you build boards and want to make something official together, we're keen to talk.

acknowledgements.title: Acknowledgements
acknowledgements.intro: Boardsesh exists because of the people who build it, back it, and put up with endless board talk. Thank you.
acknowledgements.contributorsBody: Everyone who's shipped code, fixes, and ideas on GitHub.
acknowledgements.sponsorsBody: Climbers keeping the lights on through GitHub Sponsors.
acknowledgements.sponsorsEmpty: No sponsors yet — want to be the first?
acknowledgements.privateSponsorsThanks: and {{count}} more sponsoring privately — thank you too
acknowledgements.xpremBody: Mercure Technologies gave Boardsesh an enterprise license for xprem, the server behind our over-the-air updates. It's why fixes reach your phone without waiting on an app store review, and why you can try a preview build from What's New.
acknowledgements.discordBody: Thanks for the beta, the psyche, and the bug reports. Tap to join.
acknowledgements.friendsBody: {{names}}, thanks for still wanting to sesh with me, despite me forcing everyone to beta test instead of climb. Your real world feedback has really helped set direction for Boardsesh.
acknowledgements.alexBody: For providing design feedback while in retirement from the other side of the globe — hope to cross climbing paths again some day.
acknowledgements.dogBody: Thanks Scout for all the emotional support, she's the real MVP of Boardsesh. Despite not even climbing and just wanting to be a beach dog.
acknowledgements.ossLicensesBody: The open source software Boardsesh is built on

prompt.title: See what's lit on your wall, live
prompt.body: Follow your gym's board and Boardsesh shows what's lit right now: who lit it, the grade, who set it, recent sends. You don't start anything; it's just there.
prompt.footnote: Plus crew sessions, the workout builder, and send tracking once you're on a wall.

onboarding.boardRevealTip: Tap to see what other Boardsesh users have sent to the wall.
onboarding.quickActionsTip: Long-press a climb for quick actions like queue, tick and playlists.

tips.workout: Build a workout: Volume, Pyramid, Ladder or Grade Focus. Set a grade, preview the burns, send them one at a time.
tips.crew: Climbing with people? Start a session and share one queue. Anyone sends the next burn, no passing the phone.
tips.record: Your sends chart out here on Progress: grade spread and hardest send. Import your Kilter and Tension logbook from Aurora to start with your history.
tips.accessory: The bar at the bottom is always what's on the board. Flip climbs from there.

changelog.empty: No changes logged yet — we've been too busy climbing. Check back after the next send.
